note: Stable gate ids. v6 numbering (plan v6): G0 Evidence, G1 Numerical, G2 Kernel, G3 State, G4 Product, G5 Release. Plan 5 used G2-G6 for other gates; a PASS recorded under plan-5 numbering is NEVER imported into a v6 gate of the same number (e.g. plan-5 'G3 MET' is a kernel-speed result, not v6 G3 State). A new gate or threshold needs a new definition_version and a prospective freeze.

gates.name: Evidence
gates.definition: F01-F08 plus repaired verdicts and a real baseline
gates.comparator: all F tasks Done or explicitly N/A
gates.status_reason: F01, F02, F05-F08 Partly; F04 Blocked (X1)

gates.name: Numerical
gates.metric: numerical verification of the exact final binary on all supported linear layers
gates.comparator: every criterion passes on the final binary
gates.status_reason: final combined build (lq_combined) not re-qualified on all layers; quality qualification pending (order of work 2)

gates.name: Kernel
gates.definition: K11/K12 on the final selected binary; active acceleration needs the selected full-cycle win
gates.metric: complete state-advancing layer cycle per token at batch 512 (kernel/bench_triton.py --full-cycle)
gates.comparator: lower 95% bound of (bf16 window / LeapQuant) >= 1.25 (plan-5 threshold, adopted as v6 G2's full-cycle win)
gates.status_reason: full-cycle timing not yet run; the 14 Nov component-sum result is order-dependent (inventory: 1.244 with the slower fold timing)

gates.name: State
gates.definition: S01-S10 on the selected engine: actual memory and lifecycle behaviour, support envelope
gates.metric: lifecycle tests (save/restore on outputs, branch, slot reuse, eviction, reset, cancellation) and measured total GPU bytes per arm
gates.comparator: every lifecycle case passes on the final binary; memory reconciled
gates.status_reason: restore-on-outputs test implemented, not run; memory per arm queued

gates.name: Product
gates.definition: E01-E03; matched quality, SLO, goodput and memory
gates.metric: docs/DECISIONS.md service gate: open-loop goodput (requests/s within slo-interactive-v1) at the capacity boundary vs bf16 window
gates.comparator: goodput >= +15% and the lower bound of the paired 95% interval > +5%
gates.status_reason: quality qualification pending; historical open-loop runs did not apply the p99 ITL limit and used one seed

gates.name: Release
gates.definition: E04-E08; final combined feature suite and operational readiness
gates.comparator: supported configurations named with owners and limits

history.name: plan-5 kernel speed gate
history.definition: per token at batch 512 (decode + 1/16 fold, component sum), at least 20% below bf16 window (<= 0.306 ms)
history.recorded_status: MET 14 Nov 13:08 (results/g3-final: 0.3004 vs 0.3819 ms, ratio 1.271, 10 paired runs)
history.evidence_kind: measured_raw (component sum, not a full cycle)
review_notes: the run order changes the fold time (1.04-1.07 ms after the Triton decode, 0.95 ms after v9); with the slower fold v9's ratio is 1.244 < 1.25 (historical inventory)
the 0.3817 ms control quoted with g3-final comes from results/g3 (6 runs); g3-final's own control is 0.3819 ms
history.import_into_v6: REFUSED: different numbering and boundary; v6.G2 is decided by the full-cycle timing
